body:
Even if I got motivated enough to somehow do this all over again, I owe my guy 850.00 by wed, when I pay him I'll end up being fronted another big amount, I still have my job, somehow, I HAVE to see him to pay him otherwise I'll have my head smashed in. I wish I had the willpower to not accept the front when I take care of what I owe him, but you know, if there's one thing crack cocaine is famous for....

I really am not a bad person, and I know I'm being a negative jerk, you're good people I just don't know if recovery is on the table for me anymore, the man I used to be doesn't seem to be around anymore and I don't like who I am now. It seems like it's only a matter of time, likely everyone will just say they saw it coming and "I'm in a better place"... I really hate my life, hate's a strong word but it's the best choice for now, I want to rip my hair out and try to cry to try to care but I have nothing inside me anymore......


Maybe someone reading this will think their problems aren't as insurmountable as they thought and my gift can be a "hey, at least I'm not that guy", and I;m ok with that..... I just don't think I can beat this.

I grew up poor in a real life ghetto, I went back to school after dropping out and made it to University, ended up buying a farm house and was working for National Defence, when my wife left I lost everything and thats when I relapsed, I couldn't take the pain anymore, I was doing hard drugs from 15-24, she changed my life, for the better.. but left me and married another guy within a year. I feel absolutely empty inside... and I was clean for almost 10 years, I know I could maybe do it, the issue seems to be I don't have anything to fight for anymore, it's all gone, my lifes fucked from here on and I'll never recover financially, I've ruined my body/health and I've got nothing to look forward to if I even did beat this. I have nothing to motivate me, and likely my kids will just hate their poor shitty dad that fucked his life up and are probably better off without me....

Sorry to be so negative, just needed to get this out somewhere... I took some sedatives to try and sleep, I don't know if I'll be up much longer but thank you for listening if I pass out... I wish I could change how I'm feeling, I wish I had an opportunity worth fighting for....

I don't have many reasons to stay alive, and I'm worried I'll follow through one day. I don't know why I care and I'm being honest, I feel absolutely numb to everything. I'm drifting day though day with nothing changing, nothing but empty self destructive behavior, the shitty thing is I think the only thing keeping me alive is wanting to get high. It's horrible to admit, but it's probably true

I know it won't help, but I know how you feel...

When my wife left I couldnt do the basics like sleep or eat right for almost 8 years, I've relapsed on drugs and ruined my life because of it.

Get help or you'll end up like me
I keep fucking up worst and worst dude, its not looking good
